author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
Got small dents, scratches, or imperfections in your drywall? DryDex spackling is one of the easiest ways to handle minor drywall repair before painting. It goes on pink, dries white, and helps you see exactly when it’s ready. For small drywall damage, this is faster than using regular drywall compound because you can skip the extra primer step and get back to painting.
